title: A units type with operators
description:
Make physical quantities that can be added and multiplied safely.

```
3 m + 50 cm = 3.5 m
2 m * 3 m = 6 m²
10 m / 2 s = 5 m/s
"12.5km".parse::<Length>() -> 12500 m
```
hints: `impl Mul for Length { type Output = Area; ... }`: the output type can be different from the inputs (lesson 8.02).
Adding a `Length` to a `Time` simply has no `impl`, so the compiler refuses it.
requirements: `Add` for the same kind, `Mul<Length> for Length` giving `Area`, `Div<Time> for Length` giving `Speed`, `Mul<f64>` for scaling.
`FromStr` for `Length` with `m`, `cm` and `km`; `Display` for all of them.
stretch: Make the types generic over the number type with a trait bound.
